note: Gates the game checks before it offers a quest: a relic weapon at some stage equipped or held, Eureka story and elemental level, Doman Enclave reconstruction progress. A gate Tsukimichi cannot read is listed as not checked, so the quest reads Not checked where it would otherwise read Ready (never Blocked by the gate itself). A gear gate lists its weapons under "equipped" (worn) or "held" (equipped, in the Armoury Chest or in the inventory): "items" are groups of Item row ids, any one group passing when every item of it is there (a paladin's sword and shield form one group), derived from the sheet rows in "sources" as the game-data tests check, with "shield" saying how a paladin's shield counts; it is judged from the gear the plugin captures, and reads not checked for a character captured without it. "after" names the quests before which the gate cannot be passed at all; the catalog adds them to the quest's prerequisites, with "afterTextKey" the text row of an after quest that says what it opens. "gameTextKey" is the gated quest's own text row stating the gate, when the game states one. The text is never committed. Keys are Quest sheet row ids, sorted ascending.
